items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) against rejection of MRT cost reimbursement
items.quote: Widerspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Schreibens bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse möglich, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Period is one month after Bekanntgabe. The letter has no date and no separate posting date, so the start of the period (posting day + 4 days deemed delivery under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) cannot be determined. Health insurer: delivery day does not move; only the end of the period moves to the next working day if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Without a posting date no reliable due date exists.

warnings: The letter carries no date and no posting date, so the one-month objection period cannot be calculated; count from the actual receipt/postmark (deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting) and file the Widerspruch in writing with the insurer as early as possible, ideally within one month of the day you think the letter was posted.
